description: A bright open-plan flat with a grey sofa, plants and a light wooden kitchen. A young woman with long dark hair, in a pale blue lounge set, sits on the sofa while a black-and-white border collie tugs at her sleeve. She looks startled, turns towards the kitchen, jumps up and hurries over, with her blanket lying on the floor. Behind them a steel pot on the stove is boiling over, sending up clouds of steam and water running down the oven, and the dog runs to the kitchen too.
